tasks.name: Create text input field
tasks.description: Design and implement a text input field for users to enter notes.

tasks.name: Add save button
tasks.description: Create a button that allows users to save their notes.

tasks.name: Implement save notes functionality
tasks.description: Develop backend logic to save notes entered by the user.

tasks.name: Set up database for storing notes
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store user notes.

tasks.name: Connect frontend to backend
tasks.description: Integrate the frontend save button with the backend save notes functionality.

tasks.name: Test note-saving functionality
tasks.description: Ensure that notes are saved correctly and persist in the database.

tasks.name: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the note-taking application to a live environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Use HTML to create a text input field with an appropriate ID or class for styling and JavaScript interaction.
T1.notes: Ensure the input field is styled for usability and accessibility.

T2.implementation_approach: Add a button element in HTML and style it using CSS for visibility and user interaction.
T2.notes: Assign an ID or class to the button for JavaScript event handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Write a JavaScript function to capture the input field's value and send it to the backend via an API call.
T3.notes: Validate the input data before sending it to the backend.

T4.implementation_approach: Set up a database (e.g., MySQL, MongoDB) with a table or collection to store notes, including fields for note content and metadata.
T4.notes: Ensure the database is properly indexed for efficient querying.

T5.implementation_approach: Use a framework like Express.js or Flask to create an API endpoint and connect it to the database, then integrate it with the frontend using fetch or Axios.
T5.notes: Handle CORS and authentication if required.

T6.implementation_approach: Test the note-saving functionality by simulating user input and verifying that the notes are correctly stored in the database.
T6.notes: Use both manual testing and automated test cases to ensure reliability.

T7.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a platform like Heroku, AWS, or Vercel, ensuring both frontend and backend are properly configured.
T7.notes: Test the deployed application to confirm all features work as expected.
